acceptance: The appendix SQL source is settled by an official archive or a recorded owner decision, and the shipped sourcing file says which.
context: 2026-11-24: for 0.6.0 the release gate is met by exclusion (owner decision 2026-11-24, delivered by tpcdi-appendix-sql-excluded-from-distributions-20261124 in batch release-gates): the four appendix SQL files are kept out of the wheel and sdist and stay in the repository. This item stays open and must be settled before the release that reopens TPC-DI.
description:
## Problem
Specification v1.1.0 page 117 says the appendix SQL ships as a separate archive from the TPC download section. The TPC site offers only the Tools zip (current page and Wayback snapshots 2014-2017), and the Tools zip does not contain the appendix. BenchBox currently relies on an unofficial third-party copy.

## Owner decisions
- 2026-11-21: "rely on the shared common versions for now and file a tracker to follow up on this later and settle it"

## Current source
~/Developer/tpc-tools/Appendix_v1.1.0-shared-copy/ (read-only files, SHA256SUMS, PROVENANCE.txt), fetched from github.com/abroniewski/TPC-DI-MS-SQL-Benchmark@18eca39b128f5fcc86cbc9c1e53e30ed0e685fa7 Helpers/Scripts (not from the Databricks project):
- AppendixA/tpcdi_audit.sql 60761 bytes 32eb0f55a08b8cf5a906d4aff563539d42c873c72d6dc662798218b2bc3107fc
- AppendixB/tpcdi_validation.sql 5944 bytes 9ee9ef8144c7f53bb6fb0d4ac489dda2379e7aa1b8e24d7a12df1539b7f86c02
- AppendixC/tpcdi_visibility_1.sql 5028 bytes 209454549598d8147a2a0eb9ced8bd86eb3548f32fc90c1765975b0076e8bde7
- AppendixC/tpcdi_visibility_2.sql 3362 bytes a22645d5c9d2095d8d77549db3e7ecbc8d5d5417e8f0973fbd92150347ea894a
Byte-identical across three unrelated public repos (abroniewski 2021, SonyShrestha 2023, shannon-barrow 2023; the last differs only in visibility_1). No copyright or licence notice in the files. The TPC site offers no separate Appendix download (current page and Wayback 2014-2017 checked).

## Action
1. Owner asks the TPC (info@tpc.org or a member contact) for the TPC-DI v1.1.0 appendix archive; agents never contact the TPC.
2. If it arrives: place it under ~/Developer/tpc-tools/, record name, size and SHA-256, compare the four files with the hashes above, and replace or confirm whatever BenchBox ships, updating its sourcing file.
3. If the TPC does not supply it: owner decides whether BenchBox may keep shipping the shared copy, ship it only as a local reference, or not ship it, and how the sourcing file and licence notice describe it.

## Decision gates
No BenchBox release that includes the appendix SQL until this item is done. Never source the files from the Databricks or DuckDB TPC-DI projects.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the official archive's hashes are recorded and the shipped files match it, or an owner decision on the unofficial copy is quoted here and reflected in the shipped sourcing file.
